summary: Philippine-born Canadian Romana Didulo turned a failed pandemic-era party into a QAnon following that hailed her as Queen of Canada, urging followers to stop paying bills, threatening executions and leading an RV caravan across Canada from 2021.

evidence.note: born in the Philippines, probably in the 1970s; moved to Vancouver as a teenager
2020 lockdowns prompt her to found the Canada First Party of Canada
May 2021 video proclaims her commander in chief, start of the queen persona
Arizona self-styled King of America David Carlson, said to have appointed her
claims a psychic war against Chinese troops in tunnels under Canada
her first big backer ran a crypto Ponzi scheme on Telegram
November 2021 order to shoot anyone vaccinating children; execution threats
January 2022 decree cancelling debts; followers lose utilities and homes
Corey and Daisy, Telegram moderators turned inner circle, drive her to the Ottawa convoy
followers try to arrest the Peterborough police force; several arrested
RCMP arrest her at the Richmond school compound in fall 2025, latest event covered
claims to be an alien from Arcturus sent by a divine creator

notes: Birth year is not stated beyond 'probably the 1970s'; 1975 is an estimate. A 12-minute opening segment on the 1930s I AM Activity is treated as background influence, not a subject, so it does not extend covered_span. Transcript dates the Peterborough event to August 2022. Main span ends at the 2025 arrest; story says it ends 'for now'.
